description: Durable, version-controlled, PII-free representation of the 18 governed HSE terminology decisions made during human review of the real enterprise dataset's own event_type/event_subtype terms (Real Enterprise Terminology Calibration v0.1 / Implement Approved HSE Terminology Decisions v0.1). Contains no real enterprise record IDs, workbook content, names, narratives, emails, or phone numbers -- only terminology terms (already public in docs/REAL_ENTERPRISE_DATASET_EVALUATION_REPORT.md), their occurrence counts, and the governed decision each one received. Decision UUIDs are NOT recorded here -- they are generated fresh by TerminologyMappingDecision each time this artifact is applied (see app/services/terminology_decision_artifact_service.py); this file carries only the stable scope key (source_system, domain, context, source_term) and the decided outcome, never a database identifier.

decisions.rationale: This organization's incident register files near-misses as an Incident-type record; SIE's own pre-existing NEAR_MISS SafetyEventType value is reused as the compound subtype target, never invented.

The existing WORK_AT_HEIGHT value belongs to the PERMIT domain's own subtype vocabulary, a different context; reusing it for OBSERVATION would substitute a different domain for an approximate match, which this milestone explicitly forbids.

PPE_ISSUE is not an exact semantic equivalent. PPE Compliance is a broader observation topic/category (spanning both compliant and non-compliant observations), while PPE_ISSUE denotes a specific negative finding. Approving PPE_ISSUE here would silently substitute an approximate category for an exact one. Therefore it remains rejected and quarantined. Ontology limitation: SIE's Observation subtype vocabulary has no dedicated 'PPE compliance topic/category' value distinct from 'PPE issue'.
